target: white one-story house with awning and front porch
path_basis: train-only physical-group centers interpolated as P1(q), P2(q) using the existing parent4 overlap-forward basis
route_eye: 0.5*P1(q)+0.5*P2(q), q advances over clipped target-house interval; target anchor remains fixed
lateral_eye: (1-lambda)*P1(q0)+lambda*P2(q0), lambda follows 0->1->0 cosine sweep; target anchor remains fixed
coordinate_note: Shared COLMAP arbitrary units. Native model-world matrices are recorded in the browser model registry.
